description: NVIDIA models that are known to be non-functional on NVIDIA NIM API. Distinction: 'broken' = model endpoint fails (timeout/404) regardless of account tier; 'paid_only' = model works but requires paid subscription (separate tier in remote-agents.sh). These models are hidden by default via --show-broken / 'u' toggle, NOT by --show-paid-only / 'p' toggle.

models.reason: HTTP 410 Gone: NVIDIA retired the model on 2026-10-15 ("reached its end of life on 2026-10-15T08:00:00Z"). Earlier (2026-10-10/13) it timed out on every probe.
models.evidence: 2026-10-21 dispatch smoke test, twice: HTTP 410 with the end-of-life message. Other providers listing kimi-k3 (Hugging Face, SiliconFlow, LLM7, Kilo) all answered 402 on our keys.

models.reason: HTTP 404 Not Found — function not provisioned for this NVIDIA account. Error: 'Function ... Not found for account <account-id>'. This is an account provisioning issue, not a tier restriction (would be 403/402 if paid-only).
models.evidence: HTTP 404 with explicit 'Not found for account' message. Confirmed 2026-10-10.

models.reason: Connection-level timeouts — the deployment is unresponsive for generation. The 2026-10-11 'empty completion' verdicts were partly the probe's max_tokens=24 artifact (see docs/nvidia-nim-serving-notes.md); with a 512 budget the route now times out at connect instead, so the deployment itself is degraded, not the probe.
models.evidence: 2026-10-11: 3/5 probes empty at max_tokens 24; session test timed out. 2026-10-13 re-audit with fixed probe: URLError Errno 60 operation timed out.
